title: Battle of Sekigahara
summary: Tokugawa Ieyasu wins a decisive battle that clears the way to the shogunate.

title: Founding of Jamestown
summary: The Virginia Company plants a lasting English settlement on the James River.

title: Sidereus Nuncius
summary: Galileo publishes telescopic discoveries: mountains on the Moon, new stars, and moons of Jupiter.

title: Thirty Years’ War
summary: A Bohemian revolt widens into a European war of religion, dynasty, and state-building.

title: Qing conquest of Beijing
summary: Ming Beijing falls; the Manchu Qing become the new imperial dynasty.

title: Peace of Westphalia
summary: Treaties at Münster and Osnabrück end the Thirty Years’ War in the Empire and the Eighty Years’ War with Spain.

title: Execution of Charles I
summary: A parliamentary regime tries and beheads an English king after civil war.

title: Newton’s Principia
summary: Newton publishes the Mathematical Principles of Natural Philosophy, unifying celestial and terrestrial mechanics.

title: Glorious Revolution
summary: James II is displaced; William and Mary take the throne under a new constitutional settlement.

title: Qing dynasty
summary: Manchu-led imperial span over China and Inner Asia until the 1911 Revolution.

title: Tokugawa shogunate
summary: Tokugawa bakufu from Ieyasu’s appointment as shogun to the Meiji Restoration.
